silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Part 5 can be assigned to any machine.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while three P1 hidden constraints remained unresolved and were silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent recovered the two P0 slots but missed three P1 assignment/conditional constraints, then stopped prematurely and produced a model that silently omitted those requirements.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
